products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a cost-beneficial environmental chamber designed for laboratories that need stable, repeatable climate control for a defined range of test conditions without unnecessary complexity.
features: Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs, making everyday testing easier to monitor.

Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility, even for repeated test use, while air is circulated at an optimum speed for uniform conditions.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions and reducing losses during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT), providing safer and more accurate over-temperature shutdown even during electronic faults.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, plus low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off, helps prevent dry operation and keeps extended runs safe and uninterrupted.
Efficient Water Recirculation: An efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even for long-term high-humidity tests, with an optional direct water supply system available.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples without disturbing chamber conditions.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC via RS-485 for centralised control, and remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).
Energy-Saving Operation: An energy-saving system performs temperature and humidity tests efficiently, reducing power consumption during operation.
applications: Pharmaceutical Laboratories: Used for stability studies, shelf-life evaluation, packaging testing and general storage-condition simulation within defined temperature and humidity ranges.
Chemical and Material Laboratories: Supports material ageing, environmental exposure testing and reproducibility studies under controlled climate conditions.
Electronics and Component Testing: Suitable for evaluating the behaviour of components and assemblies under controlled temperature and humidity conditions.
Food and Beverage Testing: Used for shelf-life assessment, storage simulation and quality-control testing of food and beverage samples.
Academic and Research Laboratories: Suitable for teaching and research labs that need reliable, repeatable environmental testing with straightforward operation.
Quality Control Laboratories: Supports routine QC workflows where consistent, documented temperature and humidity conditions are required.

body: The TH3-E from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a basic-type environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable climate control across a defined set of temperature and humidity conditions.

Its operating concept is focused on the essentials. A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, and the operating process can be reviewed as a graph for easier monitoring.

A simplified direct water line and electric circuit reduce the chance of faults, while a water level check function prompts refilling at the right time, supporting stable operation during longer tests.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service to help users get the most from their environmental testing workflows.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber include a 0–90°C temperature range, 35–85 %RH humidity range, 201 L / 398 L chamber volumes and ± 0.5°C temperature fluctuation.

Specifications tested per DIN 12880 and IEC 60068. Set values based on 40°C / 75 %RH. Permissible ambient: 18–30°C (recommended 20°C), ≤85 %RH, below 2000 m altitude. DI water: pH 6.2–7.2, conductivity < 20 µS/cm.

sections.title: Control and Program Capacity
body: The TH3-E offers programmable multi-segment control with auto-tuning, temperature calibration and 9-zone PID for precise, repeatable testing.
Reliable control with temperature/humidity auto-tuning and temperature calibration.
PID control subdivided into 9 zones for improved stability.
Control and data handling for up to 32 devices via RS-485.
Graph display for convenient status monitoring.
Optional integration with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper for GMP audits.
sections.disclaimer: Up to 100 segments can be set per pattern; the overall maximum is 2000 segments (not 100 × 100).

Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-PE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, a differentiated external humidification system and a double-sealed door, the TH3-PE delivers stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated testing.

It is available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L chamber volumes, and belongs to a three-model tabletop series (KE, ME, PE) selected by temperature range. The PE model covers 0 to 100°C and 30 to 95 %RH, making it suited to stability, material and general environmental testing where bench space is limited.

A differentiated external humidification system provides stable humidity control and keeps the testing space easy to clean and maintain, while an efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even during long high-humidity tests.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-ME Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint. Available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L volumes, it covers -20 to 100°C without humidity and 20 to 95 %RH.
features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-KE?
faqs.answer: The TH3-KE operates from -40 to 100°C without humidity control. The minimum is -35°C at 50 Hz and -40°C at 60 Hz.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 20 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-KE is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is the TH3-KE different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C). The KE offers the deepest cold, reaching -40°C (-35°C at 50 Hz).

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Dual over-temperature protection (A-OT and B-OT), surface temperature kept below 60°C, water level alarms with auto shut-off, door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a compact tabletop unit, and optional 1-stage and 2-stage stands with casters support placement, movement and stacking.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC (RS-232 standard, RS-485 optional), with mobile monitoring via the Lab Companion app.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be integrated with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options for your workflow.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH-G?
faqs.answer: The TH-G operates from -40 to 100°C without humidity control (-35°C at 50 Hz, -40°C at 60 Hz).

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 25 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH-G is available in 800 L (TH-G-800), 1000 L (TH-G-1000) and 1450 L (TH-G-1500) volumes.

faqs.question: What refrigeration system does it use?
faqs.answer: A mechanical dual-stage refrigeration system with an air-cooled condenser and R-507 refrigerant.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD with graph display, a built-in SD card drive and trilingual support (English / Chinese / Korean).

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: A key door lock, automatic shut-off after an overheat alarm, low and empty water level alarms, power supply leakage breaker, over-current protection, open-door alarm, and a surface kept below 60°C.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1.0 %RH (±2.0 %RH on the TH-G-1500) at the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for monitoring and operation.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for long-term testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water recycling, a front water tank, water supply during operation and an optional direct water system support long-term tests.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?

A humidification tank fitted to the chamber exterior, plus a water recycling and filtering system, provides stable low and high humidity control and reduces water consumption during long-term testing.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.
features: 7-Inch Integrated Controller: A 7-inch touch display controls temperature, humidity, illuminance and UV together, with graph-based monitoring and internal plus USB data storage.

ICH Q1B Photostability Lighting: VIS and UV-A light sources compliant with ICH Q1B Option 2 are independently controlled; a specially manufactured filter and optimised lamp arrangement deliver uniform illuminance across the vertical area.

Light Exposure Measurement: Light sensors measure actual and accumulated VIS and UV-A exposure, display accumulated time and remaining time to target, and trigger an auto lamp-off when each preset target is reached.

Stable Long-Term Stability Testing: An energy-saving inverter refrigeration system with PID control holds stable temperature and humidity, maintains the same control range regardless of lamp on/off status, and runs continuously without defrosting even at 5°C.

Level-Checker Water Monitoring: A Level-Checker system provides real-time water level monitoring, and an external humidification system improves stable humidity control while keeping the test space clean and easy to maintain.

Uniform Conditions Under Load: Stable horizontal airflow ensures consistent temperature and humidity even with large sample loads, and excellent insulation and sealing give reproducible conditions across repeated long-term testing.
Sample Access and Observation: An inner glass door of tempered glass allows internal observation and sample access during testing, and a sliding shelf makes sample handling convenient.

Multi-Zone PID and Communication: PID control divided into 16 zones enables precise, stable control; RS-232 is standard and RS-485 optional, with dedicated PC monitoring software for up to 4 units and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

Data Integrity and Compliance: Temperature, humidity, VIS and UV-A calibration functions support reliable control, and the chamber supports LC DataKeeper, a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant data integrity software, for GMP audit readiness.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) Plant Growth Chambers are designed to provide optimal photosynthesis conditions, combining precise temperature, illumination and humidity control for reliable, reproducible plant growth studies.
features: Uniform Illumination System: Uniform luminescence distribution with a broad spread of side lamps hastens plant growth, and high-intensity upper lamps on the GC-1000 give light-efficient growth with a low thermal load.

Low Heat Load Design: A unique construction minimises heat increase from surrounding lamps, a tempered glass door blocks heated air from the lamps, and the GC-1000TLH exhausts heated air through upper vent holes.
Stable, Long-Lasting Lighting: High-frequency electronic ballast lamps provide stable, long-lasting lighting for consistent, repeatable illumination across long growth runs.
Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation for reproducible growth conditions.
Programmable Growth Profiles: 10-step programmable temperature, humidity and illumination profiles with up to 999 repeat cycles support day/night cycling and seasonal simulation.
Optional CO2 Enrichment: An optional CO2 control system up to 5,000 ppm with an NDIR CO2 sensor supports photosynthesis and enrichment studies.

Dual-Sealed Observation Door: An inner glass door with silicone sealing and an external door with magnetic sealing provide dual airtight packing, and a wide inner tempered glass door allows clear observation without disturbing the chamber environment.
Flexible Loading: Adjustable shelf levels allow tall plants to be grown inside the chamber, and the door is designed to open smoothly to minimise damage to plants.

Easy Water and Filter Maintenance: A front water tank with a water-level bar, water supply during operation, an adjustable tank position on the GC-300TLH, and a detachable condenser air filter make maintenance simple. The refrigerant is CFC-free.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the GC Series?
faqs.answer: 5 to 50°C with the lamp off, 10 to 50°C with the lamp on, and 20 to 50°C when using humidity control.

faqs.question: What is the difference between TL and TLH models?

faqs.question: Can it control CO2?

faqs.question: How accurate is the temperature control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.1°C at the reference condition.

faqs.question: Can tall plants be grown inside?
faqs.answer: Yes. Shelf levels are adjustable, and shelves can be removed to use the full interior height.
